texts.preamble: Siddheshwar Baburao Bhalke vs The State Of Maharashtra on 10 September, 2025 917-ABA-1584-2025.odt In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad 917 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1584 Of 2025 Sidheshwar Baburao Bhalke, Age: 55 yrs, Occu. Business, R/o. Nalgir, Tq. Udgir, Dist. Latur ....Applicant Versus The State of Maharashtra .....Respondent ..... Mr. V. D. Gunale, Advocate for the Applicant Mr. C. V. Bhadane, App for the Respondent - State ..... Coram : Neeraj P. Dhote, J. Date : 10.09.2025 Per Court : 1. This is an Application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita Act, 2023 [hereinafter referred to as 'Bns'] for Anticipatory Bail in Crime No.259/2025 registered with Udgir City Police Station, District Latur for the offence punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 of Bns and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 2. The case of Prosecution, in brief, is that, the Police received secret information that, the Gutka Pan Masala was being transported in one vehicle and accordingly, a trap was laid.
texts.facts: 2. The case of Prosecution, in brief, is that, the Police received secret information that, the Gutka Pan Masala was being transported in one vehicle and accordingly, a trap was laid. At the instance of the auto rickshaw Driver, the Police went to one house from where the Gutka Pan Masala worth Rs.43,716/- came to be seized. From Accused No.2, the Police learnt that, the said articles belong to the Applicant. The only non offence is Section 123 of BNS. The Applicant is named by the Co-accused.
